title: Steinbeck House & Restaurant

services.name: Free Third Saturday House Tours
services.desc: Tours include all floors of the house, including John Steinbeck’s bedroom. Guests will learn about the history of the home, along with fascinating stories and little-known facts about both the house and John

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: John Steinbeck’s birthplace and boyhood home is a restored Queen Anne style Victorian built in 1897. The Steinbeck family purchased the home in 1900 and raised their family there. It was purchased by The Valley Guild in 1973.
